meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把解析好的结构化文档和你的意图转成四张卡片：蓝卡列事实、绿卡作解释、黄卡标风险、红卡给行动建议，每张卡片附来源可溯源，并写出 JSON 结果文件。
howto.when: 当你已有解析好的结构化文档和明确意图、要生成可审计的四色卡片时使用；它由通政司 Worker 主调用，黄卡与红卡分别交监察院、丞相府复核。

say.text: 用四色卡片分析这份文档，先出蓝卡和绿卡
say.note: 走 extract 阶段抽取事实与解释

say.text: 跑 review 阶段，对黄卡做过度声明复核
生成红卡，给出下一步行动建议
say.note: 走 propose 阶段补全行动策略

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a parsed document plus your intent into four cards: blue facts, green explanations, yellow risks, red actions, each with traceable sources, and writes a JSON result file.
howto.when_en: Use it when you already have a parsed structured document and a clear intent and need auditable four-color cards; it is mainly invoked by the Tongzhengsi worker, with review by Jianchayuan and Chengxiangfu.

say_en.text: Analyze this document into four-color cards, starting with blue and green
Run the review stage and recheck the yellow card for overclaims
Produce the red card with next-step action advice
